title: Can you tell me the way? — идиомы

items.example: How do I get there from here? — Take the number 5 bus.
items.mnemonic: Зебра знает get there — добраться туда.

items.example: I think we took a wrong turning — the station is back there.
items.mnemonic: Торт свернул take a wrong turning — свернуть не туда.

items.example: The museum is just around the corner from the station.
items.mnemonic: Корова around the corner — за углом.

items.example: The market is right in the heart of the old town.
items.mnemonic: Рынок с харчо right in the heart — в самом центре.

items.example: The beach is a stone's throw away from the hotel.
items.mnemonic: Пляж без стона: a stone's throw away — близко, в двух шагах.

items.example: There are three restaurants on your doorstep.
items.mnemonic: Рестораны во дворе on your doorstep — у порога.

items.example: Go past the bank and you'll come across it on the left.
items.mnemonic: Кросс через банк: you'll come across it — ты это встретишь.
